``` {r, message=F, warning=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(aod)
```


```{r}
msleep <- glimpse(msleep)
storms <- storms
lizards <- lizards
```

# MAMMALS SLEEP DATA SET
```{r}
data("msleep")
head(msleep)
```
### Q1: Use filter() to subset msleep to only animals who are awake for at least 12 hours of the day.
```{r}
filter(msleep, awake > 12)
```

# STORM TRACKS DATA
```{r}
data("storms")
head(storms)
```
### Q3:Use group_by() and summarise() to calculate the number of storms per year.
```{r}
storms_per_year <- storms %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(num_storms = n())
storms_per_year
```

### Q4:Use filter() to subset storms to only storms with wind speeds greater than 50 knots, then use arrange() to sort by wind descending.

```{r}
filter(storms, wind > 50)
arrange(storms, desc(wind>50))
```
# A COMPARISON OF SITE PREFRENCES OF TWO SPECIES OF LIZARDS
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
data("lizards")
head(lizards)
```
### Q5: Determine which Site and Diameter combination has the highest total grahami.
```{r} 
lizards_grahami <- lizards %>% 
  group_by(Site, Diameter) %>% 
  summarise(total_grahami = sum(grahami, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(total_grahami))
lizards_grahami
```
### Q6: Create a boxplot showing the distribution of _Opalinus_ counts under different light conditions (Sun vs. Shade) using ggplot2.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(lizards, aes(x = Site, y = opalinus, fill = Site)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Opalinus Counts by Site Conditions",
       x = "Site / Light Condition",
       y = "Opalinus Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```
